data_stream_notes: Gaussian independent shock indices 0 and 1, channel 0; common chi-square at shock 2, channel 1; bid/ask sign streams channels 2, assets 0 and 1. No calibration or holdout root has been consumed.

v1_retained_scientific_parameters.notes: Fixed exogenous state labels; numerical core only. Full endogenous AMS-V1 calibration and empirical release remain blocked.

v1_retention_notes: Retain seven distributions, burn-in 1000, 2000 rows/year, five years, correlation .6, original phi/sigma/bounce parameters. New V2 seed namespaces change realizations, not DGPs. V1 code/results remain untouched.

student_t5_null.definition: At each generated hour, g0,g1 independent standard normals, q independent chi-square(5). e=.01*sqrt(3/q)*(g0, .6*g0+.8*g1). Common q yields marginal t5 with unit-variance scaling and cross-asset correlation .6. Hours independent; x=r_t,y=r_(t+1).

volatility_break_null.definition: Independent correlated Gaussian martingale innovations, rho=.6. Per year use four deterministic blocks; burn-in uses .01 SD. x=r_t,y=r_(t+1), so row crossing scale break retains actual consecutive endpoints.

irregular_null.definition: Generate full V1-style IID path first. In each year retain row t only when both t and t+1 are observed. Do not compress hours. Each long missing block starts a new declared segment after it; isolated missing rows stay within that declared segment. Apply identical masks to both assets; keep original fixed state/year labels.

asynchronous_null.definition: Generate correlated simultaneous IID paths. Remove observed hour offsets divisible by the asset modulus, including zero; also ETH block. Retain each within-asset regression pair only if t and t+1 observed. Keep actual hours and labels; reset ETH continuity after block. Six primary tests use separate asset supports. Exact cross-asset join expectation is intersection of independently constructed eligible hour sets, never nearest-match or row-index match; production join proof is later full-pipeline gate.

bid_ask_bounce_interpretation: Measurement-effect diagnostic; no added null/power success criterion; invalidity remains gated.
holdout_policy: Only after unchanged calibration passes, execute separate frozen holdout and apply same thresholds. Any calibration-driven method/code adjustment creates V3, leaves V2 failed, and does not open V2 holdout to rescue it.
freeze_policy: Scientific content frozen before calibration. Any calibration-driven result-affecting change creates V3; V2 holdout may not rescue changed/failed V2.
